t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Tall hats seem to payout better. But switch up the colour to determine which one does pay well. Don't forget the spacebar.

vb_textbox.text: I found better luck with the gnome with the short hat. I tried picking based on the brighter colour but this did not give me a consistent result. I also tried picking left whenever it's x1 and right whenever it is x5, but this was also not consistent. The most consistent result I got was choosing the gnome with the shorter hat. But good luck and try to find a pattern yourself. The advice given to me was to choose the gnome with the tall hat, which actually did not work out for me.
